script.speaker: roxy
script.text: S.O.S. the coffee machine at my internship made a noise like a dying goose and quit

script.speaker: roxy
script.text: cafe lunch. today. i need a real coffee and actual food or i'm not making it to 5. let's do it!!

script.speaker: mina
script.text: a cafe sounds lovely :) roxy, are you okay? that sounds like a rough morning

script.speaker: brooke
script.text: mina!! our first lunch together since campus. i've missed you

script.speaker: mina
script.text: me too! summer has been so busy. i'm really glad it's all of you today

script.speaker: brooke
script.text: one request from me: it's been a whole week of office birthday cake, so lunch has to be the wholesome, actually-good-for-you kind

script.speaker: cyrus
script.text: I'm in. My emergency pen is in my bag, and I'd like it to stay there. Once was enough with the satay.

script.speaker: roxy
script.text: brooke told me that story on the climbing wall. nothing satay-adjacent near cyrus, got it

script.speaker: roxy
script.text: ooh and mina, remember sushi day? cyrus found you that whole section with zero meat in it

script.speaker: mina
script.text: you remember that?? i got to order whatever looked good without asking about any of it. best lunch of my summer :)

script.speaker: cyrus
script.text: Then that's the standard today. A cafe with a proper meat-free spread for Mina, not one option at the bottom.

script.speaker: mina
script.text: oh, and roxy, before you order that coffee: half a cafe menu is milk, butter or cheese. is your stomach still not speaking to them?

script.speaker: roxy
script.text: ...still not speaking. i would've remembered around the second bite. thank you mina

script.speaker: roxy
script.text: assistant, you're up. do it for the goose
